crossRefs.note: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter: the one which keeps faith.
The king rejoices in your strength, Yahweh! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!
His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.
The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.
and I will shake all nations. The precious things of all nations will come, and I will fill this house with glory, says…
‘The latter glory of this house will be greater than the former,’ says Yahweh of Armies; ‘and in this place I will give…
“Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me; and the Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to…
which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.
My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.
But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
“Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all…
Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, Yahweh will dwell there…
Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, Yahweh, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee…
When it rested, he said, “Return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”
They brought in Yahweh’s ark, and set it in its place, in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and…
The priests brought in the ark of Yahweh’s covenant to its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, to the most…
so that the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud; for Yahweh’s glory filled Yahweh’s house.
So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.
Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”
who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

translations.web: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.
translations.bsb: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
translations.kjv: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.
translations.asv: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.
